description:
Port-map §1. Byte-compatible v3 JSONL at
~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/<uuid>.jsonl.

Modules:
- OctoPi.Coder.Session.Header / Entry types
- OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore (GenServer per session id; appends
  JSONL entries; keeps a small in-memory tail for re-reads)
- OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore.Supervisor (DynamicSupervisor keyed
  on session id)
- OctoPi.Coder.Session.Encoder — matches upstream field order
  exactly; use an explicit serialization (no Map.to_list iteration
  order trust)
- OctoPi.Coder.Session.Migrations — chain v1→v2→v3 on read

Critical: key ordering of emitted JSON must match TS. Write a
fixture-based test that round-trips a known-good upstream session.

TDD:
- Append entries, read back, verify JSONL byte-equivalence with
  a pinned upstream fixture (capture ~3 small session files).
- Migration tests: v1 → v3, v2 → v3 produce byte-equal output.
- Concurrent appends from same session pid are serialized (one
  GenServer per session).

Depends on .1.
title: JSONL session store (v3 byte-compat) + migrations
